newsitem.title: USA: Delta offers Thanksgiving fare sale.
newsitem.headline: Delta offers Thanksgiving fare sale.

text.p: Delta Air Lines said it would offer special sale fares for the Thanksgiving holiday with round-trip travel on two days beginning at $96.
The company said the mileage-based sale, which went up to $196 round-trip, would be available between most cities within the 48 states that it served.
Although the fares required no advance purchase, passengers had to purchase their tickets 24 hours after reservations were confirmed, it said.
Delta said no minimum stay was required but return travel had to begin by midnight on Friday, November 29.
The fares would be non-refundable and would not be combined with any other fare.
